name: empty_composites
comment: ADR-0020 add.1: degenerate composites render their identity truth-values — empty AND is true (1 = 1), empty OR is false (1 = 0), and negation composes over them — never invalid SQL: dynamic composition legitimately produces empty lists.

sqlite.sql: select id, role_name, created_at, updated_at from roles where (1 = 1 and 1 = 0 and not 1 = 0)
